text: {"lessons":["I have tended to sell winners to lock in gains, then bought Stock B back at a higher price; I should base exits on my plan and outlook, not just the pleasure of realizing a gain.","My average cost is a reference point, not a reason to hold or sell. I should judge each position by its prospects from today’s price rather than treating it as a separate account that must get back to breakeven.","Frequent checking and trading can encourage reactive decisions. I should pause, review the whole portfolio and risks, and trade only when my reasoning has changed."]}
